findings.text: The lane exposes readable and writable control handlers for signed vectors, unsigned vectors, unsigned long vectors, single booleans, single bytes with limits, large bitmaps expressed as text, and toggleable static branches. Each handler accepts a table descriptor and a direction indicator together with a caller buffer plus length and offset cursors, and reports standard negative errno failures without partial commit on validation errors.

Scalar translation between user textual numeric domain and kernel storage is factored into small helpers for plain integers, unsigned integers, and unsigned longs, each supporting an optional caller supplied transform in either direction. The helpers separate sign handling from magnitude handling for signed values and widening or narrowing for unsigned widths, returning an error status rather than trapping on overflow.

Deferred per task callbacks can be withdrawn before execution by predicate, by callback address, or by exact queue node identity. The predicate form unlinks the first matching entry and returns it, the function form unlinks by routine address, and the node form reports whether that exact node was removed.

Task statistics collection offers a reply finalizer for generic netlink responses and a per process filler that resolves a virtual process identifier, samples statistics under current user and active pid namespaces, and releases its reference. Unknown identifiers yield a no such process failure.

Conversion dispatch is directed by a read versus write indication. The read direction only translates kernel storage toward the user domain and never validates limits or writes kernel memory, while the write direction translates toward a checked value and only updates kernel storage after all checks succeed.

When range enforcement is selected, the write path first produces a provisional scalar and then compares it against optional lower and upper limit cells referenced from the table. Values outside the inclusive interval are rejected and the live variable is left untouched, with unsigned widths reporting range error and signed width reporting invalid argument for limit violations, plus invalid argument when the table itself is absent.

Boolean and byte controls reject multi element tables and operate through a wider temporary integer delegated to the generic vector machinery. The live flag or byte is sampled before delegation and stored back only when the direction indicates a write and delegation succeeded.

A byte control with missing limit cells behaves as if bounded by zero and two hundred fifty five. A static branch control always behaves as if bounded by zero and one, reflecting disabled versus enabled. Write attempts lacking administrative capability are denied before any state change.

Large bitmap controls present set bits as comma separated decimal items where contiguous runs collapse into inclusive endpoints joined by a dash, terminated by newline. Writes accept comma separated values and ranges with newline tolerant spacing. Out of range or negative or inverted range input causes failure without committing staged changes, while successful writes either merge into the live map when resuming at nonzero offset or replace it otherwise, advancing length and offset only on success.

Write strictness defaults to strict enforcement and remains adjustable within its three level domain through a writable control. Maximum group count and last capability index are exposed as read only integer controls that never accept writes.

Unit coverage requires that writing a value one above the signed maximum through a bounded integer control fails, preserves the prior zero value, and leaves the supplied length unconsumed. The suite aggregates null data, missing length, zero length, offset read, sign handling, and both signed boundary checks under a single named collection.

Toggling a static branch serializes sampling of current state, textual conversion, and enable or disable decision under a dedicated mutex private to that handler, preventing interleaved toggles from losing updates.

Traversal and unlink of pending per task callbacks hold the target task scheduler lock with interrupts saved, using an atomic compare exchange on the predecessor link so concurrent insertion or teardown does not corrupt the list and a failed exchange retries without advancing.

Vector element width is discriminated by a three way enumeration distinguishing signed integers, unsigned integers, and unsigned longs. The active converter is carried in a union holding exactly one function pointer matching the selected width, with consistent direction, table, and cursor roles across variants.
Write strictness is modeled as a signed enumeration with legacy, warn, and strict levels. The live setting is a single static variable initialized to strict.

Task statistics listeners are tracked per processor as a list of entries carrying a process identifier plus validity flag, guarded by a read write semaphore protecting the list head. Command intent is tagged by a three way action distinguishing registration, deregistration, and processor indifference.

The integer control unit tests are organized as a null terminated array of cases gathered into a suite bearing a short name and a pointer to that array, covering null storage, unset and zero lengths, offset reads, positive and negative round trips, and both signed overflow boundaries.

Base kernel controls are declared as a static array of descriptors each naming a control, pointing at storage, stating storage width and permission bits, selecting an integer vector handler, and optionally referencing limit cells. The array is registered under the kernel namespace during early initialization.

Task statistics maintain per processor sequence counters, a global registration flag, a dedicated slab cache pointer, and a generic netlink family object, with command validation tables distinguishing task queries from group queries.

Small adapters select unchecked versus range checked conversion for each width, and vector entry points default a missing custom converter to the plain adapter except for the unsigned long path which requires an explicit converter. Direction alone determines whether user to kernel or kernel to user translation runs.

Cancellation first observes pending state without locking as a fast path, then under lock walks predecessor links and either advances past nonmatching nodes or attempts atomic unlink of a match. An exited or empty queue yields absence rather than failure.

Bitmap input larger than a page is processed in bounded chunks with progress carried across calls via length and offset, skipping leading newlines between items. Empty storage, zero length, missing map, or a read resuming at nonzero offset yields an empty result without error. Staging allocation failure aborts a write without touching live state.

All textual control handlers share a common entry role invoked with a table descriptor, direction flag, buffer pointer, length cell, and file position cell. Read calls produce text and advance cursors, write calls consume text and update kernel state only after validation.

Early initialization registers the base control array exactly once under a fixed namespace name and always reports success, establishing strictness, group maximum, capability maximum, and optional architecture specific controls.
A per processor hard interrupt work item provides a no operation notifier whose sole effect is to nudge the return to user path when deferred work was flagged from non maskable context.

User magnitudes above the unsigned thirty two bit maximum or above the signed maximum, including the asymmetric negative limit one beyond the positive maximum, are rejected without storing. The signed boundary test pins the one above maximum case to preserve prior storage and length.

When the configuration disables textual controls, every handler and scalar converter in this lane has a fallback variant that unconditionally reports not implemented, so callers must handle absence rather than assuming success or partial effect.

Live scalar control values are sampled and stored through single copy accessors that tolerate concurrent readers and writers without tearing, with range checked writes validating a provisional copy before publishing.

A tiny cursor helper advances past repeated instances of a chosen separator while decreasing the remaining count. Unsigned long translation without limits always succeeds after applying any optional transform, whereas the checked vector path for that width still enforces table bounds.

A shared integer limit table holds zero, one, two, three, four, one hundred, two hundred, one thousand, three thousand, signed maximum, sixty five thousand five hundred thirty five, and negative one. A shared unsigned long table holds zero, one, and the unsigned long maximum. The scratch textual buffer width is twenty two.

Write strictness levels are encoded as negative one for legacy, zero for warn, and one for strict, with strict as the initial value and the writable strictness control bounded by negative one and one.

Base control permission encodings are six four four for writable entries and four four four for read only maxima. Vector text treats space, tab, and newline as separators, while bitmap text uses dash for ranges, comma between items, and newline termination.

The cpumask registration string limit is one hundred plus six per configured processor. Command validation expects thirty two bit process and thread group identifiers plus optional registration strings for task queries, and a thirty two bit file descriptor for group queries.
